about: compiler/cases mutants covering missing expected.out, invalid exit status, trailing newline markers in Diff, and memory limit judgment

mutants.name: selfhost-cases-load-require-expected-out
mutants.rule: loadCaseInto must reject case folders missing expected.out unless recording.

mutants.name: selfhost-cases-load-status-leading-zero
mutants.rule: parseDecimalExitStatus must reject leading-zero exit status values such as 01.

mutants.name: selfhost-cases-diff-missing-trailing-newline
mutants.rule: formatHunk must emit the no-newline marker when a diff line lacks a trailing newline.

mutants.name: selfhost-cases-judge-ignore-memory-limit
mutants.rule: Judge must fail fatally with the memory limit diagnosis when Outcome.Limited is true.
